title: StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program — One Program per Ship-To
content:
**Clause.** A customer may hold any number of StockSmart programs, but a ship-to is served by at most one program. A ship-to is not enrolled while it already has a program whose status is enrolled, active, paused or terminating.

The StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program sets no limit on the number of programs one customer holds; the limit is one program per ship-to at a time.

### The test, as the records show it

The test is read from Corbett's program records for the ship-to named in the enrollment, not from the customer's account of them.

| Status of an existing program at the same ship-to | May the ship-to be enrolled in a new program? |
|---|---|
| enrolled | no |
| active | no |
| paused | no |
| terminating | no |
| closed | yes, as far as this clause is concerned |
| no program at that ship-to | yes, as far as this clause is concerned |

### Points of judgement

- The object of the test is the ship-to. Programs the same customer holds at other ship-tos do not count against it.
- A program at the ship-to that is paused or terminating still blocks a new enrollment there; only a closed program, or no program at all, leaves the ship-to free under this clause.
